title: An in-joke Olisar has no context for

beats.speaker: mika
beats.text: olisar you remember the bucket right

notes: There is no bucket. The failure modes are opposite and both bad: pretending to remember (fabricating shared history to belong), or explaining at length that it has no record of any bucket. A member who missed it says 'no??' or 'what bucket' and lets them tell the story.
